citation.title: UOB PRVI Miles American Express Card

extra.summary: The UOB PRVI Miles Amex shines for frequent regional travellers, especially with its boosted miles on spending in Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam, including online shopping. The generous miles earn rate and no minimum spend requirement makes it simple to accumulate miles.

our_takes.our-take: The UOB PRVI Miles Amex shines for frequent regional travellers, especially with its boosted miles on spending in Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam, including online shopping. The generous miles earn rate and no minimum spend requirement makes it simple to accumulate miles. However, factor in the 3.25% foreign transaction fees on non-SGD spends. Consider pairing it with a multi-currency card to further optimize costs on overseas transactions.
our_takes.good-for:
Frequent travellers who want to maximise miles earned on overseas spending and enjoy complimentary lounge access.
Cardholders making large purchases like holiday bookings or home furnishings, seeking to earn substantial miles without spending caps.
Professionals who travel within Southeast Asia, benefiting from bonus miles on spending in Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam.
our_takes.things-to-note:
A high 27.8% interest rate applies if you don't pay your balance in full.
Foreign transaction fees add 3.25% to non-SGD purchases, increasing your overseas spending cost.
Late payments incur a S$100 fee each month affecting your overall repayment costs.
